name: Ash Hair Salon
tagline: Cute Styles. Happy Girls. Confident Everyday!
description: Ash Hair Salon specializes in little girls' braids — knotless braids, box braids, beaded styles, cornrows, and more — with a kid-friendly experience, gentle care, and neat, long-lasting styles she'll love.

hero.title: Beautiful braids, made with love.
hero.subtitle: Knotless braids, box braids, beaded styles, and cornrows for little girls — gentle care, neat and long-lasting styles, and a fun, kid-friendly experience. Book today!

stylists.name: Owner
stylists.title: Founder & Kids' Braider
stylists.bio: The founder of Ash Hair Salon creates beautiful braids made with love for little girls — gentle, patient, and kid-friendly, because every little girl deserves to feel confident. Follow her work on TikTok @gorgeousasha.

reviews.name: Tiffany M.
reviews.text: My daughter usually cries getting her hair done, but not here! So gentle and patient, and the beaded braids are adorable.

reviews.name: Keyana R.
reviews.text: Her knotless braids lasted almost a month and still looked neat. My little girl felt like a princess.

reviews.name: Shante B.
reviews.text: Cutest cornrows with puffs for picture day! Everyone asked who did her hair.

reviews.name: Danielle P.
reviews.text: Such a warm, kid-friendly experience. My daughter can't wait for her next appointment.
